name: number-field
title: Number field
description: A number you step, scrub or type, at Field's sizes: keycaps (the set's minus and plus) concentric with the well; each step turns the value on the drum and a step past a limit shakes only the digits. Alt and Shift step fine and coarse and say so on the keycaps; an engraved unit; typed arithmetic read back before it commits; soft limits; back to default with the changed mark; mixed values; an inspector kind with a letter as the scrub handle; the wheel only when focused.
